title: Invertibility survives a controlled perturbation
promptMarkdown: Let $A$ be invertible and $\|A^{-1}\|\|E\|<1$. Prove $A+E$ is invertible and derive bounds for $\|(A+E)^{-1}\|$ and $\|(A+E)^{-1}-A^{-1}\|$.
hintLadder: Factor out A on the left.
Derive the difference-of-inverses identity rather than commuting the factors.

criteria.criterion: Factors correctly and proves norm convergence of the inverse series.
